newsitem.title: FRANCE: PARIS BOURSE FLATTENS AFTER EU DEAL.
newsitem.headline: PARIS BOURSE FLATTENS AFTER EU DEAL.

text.p: French shares little changed after EU leaders reach compromise agreement on EMU budget stability pact with resolution for jobs and growth. The deal boosted the franc and dollar against the mark.
* CAC-40 index down 0.02 point at 2,808.50 at 1315 GMT. It hit all time high of 2,825.18 earlier on expectation agreement would be struck and latest gains on Wall Street. Profit taking seen.
* CAC-40 Jun futures 2,795 vs 2,793 at Fridays close.
